responsibility: Implements the cost-analysis and caching side of the inliner. It computes inline-failure initialization, edge growth caches, call-context caches, estimated size/time changes for inlining edges, derived inline hints, caller/callee growth accounting, offline-copy savings, and quick positivity tests for whole-node growth. This file provides the quantitative analysis primitives used by the early and IPA inliners, while the actual inlining decisions and body rewrites live in ipa-inline.cc and ipa-inline-transform.cc.
